description: Is this wallet, X account or person trustworthy? Ethos credibility score (0 to 2800) and level, from untrusted to renowned, built from peer reviews, ETH-backed vouches, slashes and linked on-chain and social history. Use it before trading with, following, quoting or paying an unknown counterparty, to rank accounts by reputation, or to flag likely scams and bots. Takes an EVM address, X handle or account id, Discord or Telegram id, or Ethos profile id. Free, no payment or key; the same answer as the free Ethos API. Example input: {"userkey":"service:x.com:username:ethos_network"}. Example output: {"score":2441,"level":"revered"}

userkey.description: An Ethos userkey: address:0x… (EVM address), profileId:<n>, service:x.com:<X account id>, service:x.com:username:<X handle>, service:discord:<id> or service:telegram:<id>.
